requirements.title: CHARACTER_KINDS lists supported character kinds with required shape
requirements.source: S16.10.2.4 p1 required values and shape; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF472.
requirements.definition: The elements of CHARACTER_KINDS are the kind values supported for character variables; the array has rank one, lower bound one, and size equal to the number of supported character kinds.

pending.character-kinds-default-kind-listed: Use ISO_FORTRAN_ENV, assert ANY(CHARACTER_KINDS == KIND('A')) with the literal 'A' as the default character exemplar; mutate the comparison kind to a sentinel value absent from CHARACTER_KINDS.
pending.character-kinds-rank-one-lower-bound-one: Use RANK(CHARACTER_KINDS), LBOUND(CHARACTER_KINDS, 1), and SIZE(CHARACTER_KINDS), asserting 1, 1, and a positive size; mutate each expected scalar separately.
pending.character-kinds-supported-kind-exhaustiv: No portable oracle in one fixed source file can prove absence of additional character kinds beyond CHARACTER_KINDS because character kind type parameters cannot be enumerated dynamically by standard Fortran source; future profile generators may add processor-specific declarations without suite-wide conformance credit.

requirements.source: S16.10.2.4 p1 order sentence; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF472.
requirements.definition: The order of the values in CHARACTER_KINDS is processor dependent.
